50607424.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity Bcl-xL by isothermal titration calorimetry assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Instruments, Inc., Northampton, MA) at 25 °C. The protein (Bcl-xL) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.4, and concentrated to 100 μM. The ligand (compound 6f) was dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 100 μM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The heat of dilution was determined by titrating the ligand into buffer and subtracted from the raw data. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated from the binding isotherm.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT
